stock_cuda_image.provisional_feasibility: Source/documentation suggests compatibility with stated Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA 12.8, driver 570 target; actual stock image contents and exact driver patch unverified.
required: CUDA-capable GPU supported by hardcoded sample architecture list
stock_cuda_image.driver_evidence: CUDA 12.8 GA corresponding Linux driver >=570.26, confirmed in NVIDIA release notes; driver major 570 alone does not establish patch compatibility.
stock_cuda_image.reason: No build/workload run authorized; exact image, GPU and driver patch unavailable. Brief reports conflicting README toolkit versions 12.5/12.6/12.8.

size.reason: No external dataset; generated allocation sizes and peak host/device/runtime working set not established. Do not materialize option-by-path product as assumed memory footprint.

scoring.reserve: Add Confidence / abs(MC-BS) only if absolute error > 1e-6; divide by all options. Confidence is discounted 1.96-standard-error width.
scoring.acceptance: Unrounded average reserve > 1; final verdict passes and exit status succeeds.
scoring.l1_reason: No published numeric target or acceptance threshold in brief.

repeatability.limitations: GPU geometry changes random streams; libc affects generated inputs. No bitwise cross-device reproducibility claim.
repeatability.repeat_count_reason: No repeat count prescribed by sources.
